subject: general
question: Which of the following dance performances begins with the Kelikottu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kelikottu** is the traditional drum performance that marks the commencement of a Kathakali performance.
 
• Kathakali is a classical dance-drama form originating from **Kerala**, India.
 
• The art form combines elaborate costumes, intricate makeup, and facial expressions to narrate stories from epics like the **Ramayana** and **Mahabharata**.
 
• Kelikottu involves percussion instruments such as the **chenda** and **maddalam**, setting the tone for the dramatic enactment.
 
• It is performed to invite the audience and signify the beginning of the storytelling through dance and drama.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• It is known for its elaborate costumes, which include a crown (headgear), painted faces, and vibrant attire, symbolizing different characters.
 
• The stories performed in Kathakali are primarily derived from Hindu mythology, emphasizing themes of good versus evil.
 
• Performers undergo rigorous training to master the art of **mudras** (hand gestures) and facial expressions (**rasas**) to convey emotions effectively.
 
• The accompanying music and vocalists play a crucial role in enhancing the dramatic effect of the performance.
